$Comment: The Horseman's Head, flown off his shoulders mid-fight: a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive carrying the game's Incandescent skull's own Modify, with its look and its health. It circles the players and throws nothing: RangedAttack is empty, which switches off the template's whole ranged attack (its Enabled reads !isEmpty(RangedAttack)), since nothing in this fight is thrown at a player without a warning ring. While it flies, the Horseman's body cannot be hurt; killing it is how players break that, which the fight's script watches for. It only exists inside his fight. Fire hurts it at half (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Fire_Ward in _CombatConfig), DropList Empty. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
